links.comparator_used: Same general-purpose chatbots (ChatGPT 5.2, Perplexity Pro) non-primed, without the summarized guideline document
links.outcome: Accuracy versus IADT guideline recommendations for follow-up interval and radiographic recommendations in primary dentition trauma scenarios
links.effect: Priming significantly improved general-purpose chatbot performance, with marked gains in follow-up interval accuracy and radiographic recommendations. All chatbots had complete diagnostic accuracy. Exact figures are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Priming significantly improved the performance of general-purpose chatbots, with ChatGPT and Perplexity demonstrating marked gains in follow-up interval accuracy and radiographic recommendations.

links.comparator_used: General-purpose chatbots (ChatGPT 5.2, Perplexity Pro), non-primed and primed with a guideline summary
links.outcome: Accuracy versus IADT guidelines for immediate management, follow-up interval and radiographic recommendations
links.effect: The domain-specific chatbot reached 100% accuracy in immediate management, with minor inaccuracies in the general-purpose models. All chatbots had complete diagnostic accuracy. For follow-up interval and radiographic recommendations, the primed general-purpose models showed greater agreement with IADT guidelines than the domain-specific chatbot.
links.quote: The domain-specific chatbot achieved 100% accuracy in immediate management decisions, while minor inaccuracies were observed among general-purpose models.
